newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline stable, U.S. arb shut.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline stable, U.S. arb shut.

text.p: NWE gasoline was stable on Friday and markets were tight, traders said.
U.S. arbitrage opportunities were considered closed as NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures erased earlier strong gains.
Eurograde barges were talked at around $204/$206 fob ARA in late business and trade was heard done at $208 earlier, while futures screens were strong.
One dealer said two Italian mixed Eurograde/superplus cargoes had been bought by a trader on a quotes-related basis. These cargoes were seen likely to move northwards.
